summary: You need 135 graduate units, of which at most 10 units of PE courses count, plus CS 300, at least three units of CS 499, and the foundation courses CS 103, 109, 111 and 161 (taken or waived; a waiver is marked by hand). Breadth takes three courses from three different areas, each letter graded with a B+ or better. CPT units (CS 390A-C) are optional. You check by hand the 3.0 GPA, three units of coursework with each of four faculty members, the qualifying exam, reading committee, thesis proposal, teaching, candidacy, oral exam and dissertation. The B+ floor is applied to breadth only, because the text gives it only there.
